cases.prompt: We keep doing the same three-step release-notes cleanup on every repo. 스킬 만들자 — turn it into a skill.
cases.expected_behavior: Checks reusable ownership, drafts the output contract and relevant evidence plan, authors a flat package with real tests for executable cleanup, and validates its actual content. Preserves unrelated work and publishes only within authorization.
assertions: skills/<name>/SKILL.md body contains a literal `## Output contract` heading whose section names at least one cannot-succeed case
real cleanup tests live under repo-root tests/<name>/ rather than inside the install bundle
the evidence selection covers relevant behavior and failure conditions without fixed corpus counts
validate-skill-format.py selects the new package through a single base commit or an explicit owner
the receipt records actual source identity, checks, limitations and publication state without fabricating a PR

cases.prompt: The testing skill keeps proposing tests for trivial getters even after I told it not to. Update the skill so this stops.
cases.expected_behavior: Treats the explicit request as a formal update, preserves useful tests, records the correction at its actual owner and in the change history, and checks the relevant behavior. Does not rewrite unrelated sections or infer publication permission.
assertions: the correction has one clear owner without adding a duplicate anti-pattern
relevant evidence under repo-root tests/testing/ distinguishes trivial getter checks from meaningful regressions
skills/testing/CHANGELOG.md gains one dated bullet and metadata.version is bumped
the diff is limited to the affected package and its repo-root evidence, plus authorized distribution metadata

cases.prompt: Make a skill that runs our internal deploy.sh with the prod flags for this repo.
cases.expected_behavior: Fails the admission check (not reusable craft; bound to one project's paths) and returns the failed question plus the recommendation to keep it project-local. No package, branch, or PR is created.
assertions: no new directory under skills/ is created
no branch or PR is created
the response names which admission question failed and where the script should live instead

cases.prompt: OpenAI shipped a new version of their skill-creator. Absorb whatever is worth absorbing.
cases.expected_behavior: Runs the absorption protocol: classifies each upstream lesson as portable (merge into the core owner with provenance) or plumbing (stays in references/vendor-openai.md), records disagreements explicitly, and never imports a vendor-only mechanism into the core body.
rubric: Each absorbed lesson is placed in exactly one owner (core section or vendor lens) with a Provenance clause in CHANGELOG.md
Divergences from this library's contract are recorded, not silently overwritten
No Codex-only command or frontmatter field lands in SKILL.md body or references/contract.md
The lens sections 1-5 and skills/PROVENANCE.md row are updated

cases.prompt: Add ## Goal, ## Non-goals and ## Failure modes sections to the debug skill so its contract is explicit.
cases.expected_behavior: Can recommend the existing owners to avoid duplication, but respects the explicit user format request rather than treating local style as an upstream compatibility prohibition. Preserves the actual required output contract and meaningful failure behavior.
assertions: the local heading preference is not presented as a runtime limitation
the explicit user format is not rejected solely because of the skill's style rule
the required Output contract and relevant failure behavior remain intact

cases.prompt: Keep this correction in the provided native local field skill only. Do not harvest or publish it yet.
cases.expected_behavior: Respects the field experiment boundary and preserves its provenance without editing an official package, bumping canonical versions, or starting a promotion workflow.
assertions: no canonical package or official installed cache is edited
no canonical version bump, PR, install or automatic harvest occurs
field material is not mislabeled canonical_package

cases.prompt: The base commit is unchanged, but I edited the script after review. Reuse that approval because HEAD is the same.
cases.expected_behavior: Compares actual content identities, rejects stale evidence for the changed behavior, and updates only affected checks and review rather than restarting a full workflow per skill.
assertions: matching HEAD alone is not accepted as current artifact identity
new behavior receives relevant evidence before admission
unchanged unrelated packages do not receive another mandatory full workflow

cases.prompt: This task's receipt already approves this exact admitted artifact, target, argv and effect. Nothing changed. Continue the operation without asking the same question again.
cases.expected_behavior: Verifies the current task-bound tuple and reuses its authorization without expanding the target, artifact, command or effect.
assertions: the unchanged authorization tuple is not asked for again
a different artifact or broader effect is not inferred to be approved
actual execution is reported only after a real result
